parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system services dhcp pool pool1 rang.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] range low [parameter2] high [parameter3]
set system services dhcp pool pool1 rang.command: set system services dhcp pool pool1 range low 10.10.0.2 high 10.10.0.100
set system services dhcp pool pool1 rang.explanation: 配置DHCP服务的地址池范围。

set system services dhcp pool pool1 rout.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] router [parameter2]
set system services dhcp pool pool1 rout.command: set system services dhcp pool pool1 router 10.10.0.1

set system login user admin authenticati.template: set system login user [parameter1] authentication plain-text-password
set system login user admin authenticati.command: set system login user admin authentication plain-text-password
set system login user admin authenticati.explanation: 配置用户使用明文密码进行认证。

set system login user admin class super-.command: set system login user admin class super-user

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 3.3.3.3/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 11.11.11.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: 目标网络的子网掩码位数。
